text:
Amelia: Quick design review for the single-key onboarding empty state — thinking about CTA wording, skeleton layout, and the 'secret shown once' reminder. Fig link in thread: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234 (mock attached). Idea: a compact card + skeleton + primary CTA. Thoughts? Jordan: I prefer 'Create API key' (shorter, matches search). Make CTA full-width primary, secondary 'Learn more' tiny. :thumbsup: Samir: A11y nits: button aria-labels need context, focus management after creation, and do NOT auto-copy secret. Also ensure the toast uses aria-live. Casey: For the secret reveal, we should show an ephemeral toast with an Undo link for 5s and a clear warning 'This secret is shown only once'. Also expose which services will be affected by revoke/rotate. Amelia: Agreed. Mock currently says 'Create your first API key' vs 'Create API key' — which do we land on for discoverability? Also want copy that warns about one-time visibility. Suggested line: "You’ll only see this key once — save it now." Jordan: Microcopy tweak: change 'save it now' -> 'store it securely' (more precise). Also call out scope/perms on the row as a small pill: e.g., 'read-only', 'embedding', etc. Samir: Keyboard flow: after the drawer closes the focus should land on the newly created row. Use aria-live=\"assertive\" for toasts: users need immediate SR feedback. Example snippet below for the Show secret button and toast: ```
API key created. Secret displayed once.
``` Casey: Rotation/Revoke: add a soft-delete grace period (soft revoke) with undo on toast, and a pre-revoke checklist listing dependent integrations. For rotation UX, maybe an inline assistant that walks through swap steps. Amelia: UX question — inline expand for rotation vs modal confirm. Inline is faster, modal is clearer for destructive ops. Maybe do inline + a final confirm modal if dependencies detected. Jordan: Inline expand with clear CTA > 'Rotate & notify' might be nice (power users can do quick rotate). For empty states, make the CTA language actionable and include a one-liner explaining why you need a key. ux-bot: Accessibility checklist reminder: run color-contrast checks on pill chips, validate focus order, add aria-live region for toasts, ensure show/ hide secret button has accessible label, and run aXe on the branch. Samir: I'll PR the a11y fixes and add the copy variants into Figma comments (3 options for the one-time notice). Also will add keyboard-focus tests. :rocket: Amelia: Thanks — can we aim to pick copy + land initial layout by EOD Wednesday? Then quick usability test with 3 devs Thursday morning. Casey: I'll schedule a 15-min walkthrough after copy is final. Jordan: I'll update the pattern library with the CTA variants and pill styles, then point the demo app to the new component. Amelia: Perfect. Leaving a couple of action items in the doc: Samir (a11y PR), Jordan (component), Casey (usability session), Amelia (final copy sign-off).
